newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy March CPI seen at 0.1 pct m/m, 2.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italy March CPI seen at 0.1 pct m/m, 2.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italian March inflation is seen at 0.1 percent month-on-month and 2.2 percent year-on-year, according to analysts' estimates after preliminary data from seven sample Italian cities on Thursday.
February consumer prices stood at 0.1 percent month-on-month and 2.4 percent year-on-year.
A further four cities, Florence, Naples, Bari and Palermo, release their preliminary March data on Friday.
The 11 cities have a combined weighting of 75.66 percent on the national index. Final March CPI will be released by national statistics institute Istat on April 7.
